topic: 3 mistakes beginners make with their first 10 reels
Why I use an AI version of my own voice (and what it can't do)

script: Want to post every day without filming every day? Here's my system. I write one line idea in a spreadsheet. An AI drafts the script in my style, and I approve it. Then my AI avatar records it in my own voice, with captions and music. I watch it once, and it's scheduled. That's it. Follow for more behind the scenes.
